newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pioneer up on bright earnings outlook.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer up on bright earnings outlook.

text.p: Shares in Pioneer Electronic Corp climbed on Wednesday as investors were encouraged by the bright earnings outlook the firm released last week, traders said.
The shares of the audio equipment maker briefly hit 2,770, a high for the calendar year.
As of 0423 GMT, the share was up 140 yen at 2,720. Turnover was 1.043 million shares.
"The firm is expected to show profits for 1997/98, and that encouraged investors, as the issue had been weak due to sluggish earnings in the past," said a broker at a Big-Four securities house.
Last week, Pioneer said it expected to post parent current profits of 4.80 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, against parent current losses of 4.10 billion yen a year earlier.
It also said it expected to post group net profits of 2.51 billion yen for 1997/98, against group net losses of 9.99 billion yen a year earlier.
